methods.label: Complete the shaded region to a triangle
methods.explanation:
The five unit squares have total area \(5\), so the shaded region must have area \(\frac52\). Its stepped boundary suggests filling the lower-right notch: add the missing unit square with opposite corners \((2,0)\) and \((3,1)\).

This produces precisely the right triangle with vertices \((a,0)\), \((3,0)\), and \((3,3)\). Its area is therefore
\[
\frac52+1=\frac72.
\]
The vertical height is \(3\). Since a triangle's area is half its base times its height, its horizontal base has length
\[
\frac{2\cdot\frac72}{3}=\frac73.
\]
That base runs from \(x=a\) to \(x=3\), so
\[
a=3-\frac73=\boxed{\frac23},
\]
which lies on the indicated bottom edge and gives choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
